name: backlink-autofill
description: Project-isolated backlink submission workflow that uses the current Codex/ChatGPT model, browser tools, one shared submitter profile, and selected-project-only assets without a separate LLM API.

interface.shortDescription: Fill vetted backlink forms with isolated project data
interface.longDescription: Select one project explicitly, combine its reviewed SEO data and private assets with one shared submitter profile, work through vetted backlink targets in the user's browser, and stop before final submission.
defaultPrompt: Use $backlink-autofill for the selected project and stop before the final submit action
